missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Немец' is in the nominative as the subject. 'Этот' agrees in masculine nominative, and 'говорит по-русски' describes his ability.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate object. 'Немца' is animate masculine with a fleeting vowel that drops, so its accusative copies the genitive. 'Одного' agrees in animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Немца' is genitive after 'у', the fleeting е dropping before the ending. 'Этого' agrees, and 'красивый дом' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Немцу' is the dative indirect object, the one shown around. 'Город' is the accusative thing shown. The fleeting е again drops in the dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'Немцем' is instrumental after 'с' to express working together. 'Этим' agrees in masculine instrumental; the fleeting е drops here too.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об немце' uses the prepositional form after 'об' to mark the topic. 'Этом' agrees in masculine prepositional, naming the man discussed.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Немцы' is the nominative plural acting as the subject. 'Любят' agrees in the plural, and 'порядок и точность' are the accusative objects.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate plural. 'Немцев' is animate plural, so its accusative copies the genitive. 'Многих' agrees in the same animate form, marking a large group.

missions.phrase: В нашем городе живёт много немцев.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantifier. 'Немцев' is genitive plural because 'много' governs that case. 'В нашем городе' sets the location, and 'живёт' is the verb.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Немец' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Типичный' and 'вежливый' agree in masculine nominative, characterizing him.
